instructions.title: Enter the Terrain Rover
instructions.message: Locate the rover near the SOL 02 starting point and enter through the ladder.
instructions.guidance: Approach the rover ladder and press E to climb inside the rover cabin.
instructions.activity: Approach the rover ladder and press E to enter the rover interior.

instructions.title: Initiate Night-time Soil Investigation
instructions.message: Access the Mission OS main computer and initiate the SOL 02 mission log.
instructions.guidance: Access the central command console inside the rover cabin and submit the initial mission record.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to open the Mission Operating System.

instructions.title: Check Night-time Environmental Conditions
instructions.message: Record night-time temperature, pressure, wind and atmospheric CO2 readings.
instructions.guidance: Approach the environment sensor display station and record external telemetry.
instructions.activity: Approach Environment_Checking_Trigger and press E to record environmental conditions.

instructions.title: Inspect Soil Sampling Tools
instructions.message: Verify the soil scoop, containment canisters, and seal integrity.
instructions.guidance: Inspect the tool rack to ensure all sampling instruments are calibrated and ready.
instructions.activity: Approach Tool_Section_Trigger and press E to inspect and confirm sampling tools.

instructions.title: Check Water and Nutrient Supplies
instructions.message: Verify remaining water and nutrient reserve levels before rover departure.
instructions.guidance: Examine the life-support resource dispenser and record reserve telemetry.
instructions.activity: Approach Water_and_nut_Trigger and press E to record resource reserves.

instructions.title: Drive to Sol2_Checkpoint
instructions.message: Follow the navigation beam across the night-time terrain to the checkpoint.
instructions.guidance: Drive the rover toward Sol2_Checkpoint. Keep headlights on for maximum surface visibility.
instructions.activity: Drive the rover to within 50 meters of Sol2_Checkpoint.

instructions.title: Collect Martian Soil Sample
instructions.message: Exit rover on foot, proceed to the investigation site, and extract the sample.
instructions.guidance: Exit the rover, walk to Sol2_Mission_investigation, and press E to collect the soil core.
instructions.activity: Approach Sol2_Mission_investigation on foot and press E to extract soil sample.

instructions.title: Return to Rover and Store Soil Sample
instructions.message: Return to the rover and secure the soil sample in the onboard specimen bay.
instructions.guidance: Climb into the rover through the ladder to transfer and secure your sample.
instructions.activity: Approach the rover ladder and press E to store sample in the rover.

instructions.title: Run Automated Soil Sample Analysis
instructions.message: Initiate automated spectroscopic and mineralogical analysis via Mission OS.
instructions.guidance: Open the Mission OS to begin automated sample analysis and monitor results.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to run automated analysis.

instructions.title: Compile and Save Scientific Report
instructions.message: Review the scientific sample findings and save the final Sol 02 research report.
instructions.guidance: Submit your scientific report with mineral composition and moisture assessment.
instructions.activity: Approach Main_Screen_Trigger and press E to save the scientific report.

instructions.title: Drive to Sol2_Finishing_Point
instructions.message: Follow the navigation beam to the mission culmination terminus.
instructions.guidance: Drive the rover across the dark plain to Sol2_Finishing_Point.
instructions.activity: Drive the rover to within 50 meters of Sol2_Finishing_Point.

instructions.title: Complete SOL 02 Mission
instructions.message: Exit the rover and validate SOL 02 mission completion.
instructions.guidance: Exit the rover, approach the finishing marker, and press E to finalize SOL 02.
instructions.activity: Exit rover and press E at finishing point to complete SOL 02.

completion.title: SOL 02 MISSION COMPLETE
completion.message: All SOL 02 scientific objectives validated. Preparing transfer to SOL 03.
